description: The code-only release that heals a pool whose runtime runs but refuses: exactly the code policy, plus a stated root restart. The new controller code stops that runtime gracefully and its recovery starts a new one, so acceptance waits for the new boot and then requires every request on it. A failure is not rolled back: the code before it could not restart the pool.

rootRestart.why: About 60 s for the fix to act, a graceful stop of up to 30 s, one recovery pass of up to 200 s (startup allows 180 s), and the peer bootstrap and membership pass before the pool serves.
